description: This file defines the DocumentInfo class, which contains metadata about a document such as title, author, keywords, subject, and comment. It includes properties for getting and setting these values, cloning the object, and serializing its data.

classes.name: DocumentInfo
classes.description: Represents document metadata such as title, author, keywords, subject, and comment. Provides methods for cloning and serialization.

classes.name: DocumentInfo.DocumentInfoValues
classes.description: Holds internal nullable values for the DocumentInfo properties.

methods.name: DocumentInfo(DocumentObject parent)
methods.description: Internal constructor associating the object with a parent DocumentObject.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the DocumentInfo object.

methods.name: Serialize(Serializer serializer)
methods.description: Serializes the DocumentInfo properties into DDL format.
